JoinTeleVip: Join the TeleVip channel to be among the first to get the latest updates and new features
MarkReadAfterSend: Mark messages as read after sending or tap a reaction
OfflineVisibilityInfo: When the “Hide Online Status” feature is enabled, your online status will not be completely hidden. Instead, it reduces how often you appear as online. You may still appear online when interacting with the app, such as sending messages, reacting to them, or reading messages. Your status will return to offline after about 30–60 seconds. For the best result, it is recommended to enable all Ghost Mode options.

OpenGhostMode: Would you like to open Ghost Mode now?
ApproximateCreationDateNotice: This date is based on an estimate derived from the Telegram ID and may not match the actual creation date.
BlockAds: Block ads (channels, search, video and proxy promo)
ProtectionWarning: Some TeleVip protection could not be initialized or completed. Normal networking is available. Recognized privacy requests are still blocked, but full protection is not confirmed. Restart Telegram; if this continues, update TeleVip before relying on privacy switches.
NoEditHistory: No recorded edit history for this message.
NoPrivacyHookIssue: No privacy hook initialization issue reported.
VerifiedApkChecks: This exact Play APK is in the static compatibility test baseline.
UnknownApkChecks: This exact APK has not been verified. A matching version number alone is insufficient.
CompatibilityLimits: Hook counts cover enabled features. Loaded hooks and static APK checks do not prove server-side read privacy, remote deletion or expiring-media behavior. No report is uploaded.
ArchivedMedia: Media message (binary media files are not included)
ArchiveViewerNotice: Copies for the current account are kept here independently of Telegram’s chat cache. Text/captions and message metadata are retained; media files are not copied.
ArchiveEmpty: No matching copies. Recording starts after you enable independent copies and Show deleted messages. Messages already lost cannot be recovered.
ForgetArchiveNotice: Remove only this module’s saved copy. It will also be excluded from future imports of old backups. The Telegram message is unchanged.
ArchiveExported: Current-account copies were exported. Media files are not included.
ArchiveImported: Imported %s new copies. Existing copies and deliberate removals were preserved.
ArchiveExportNotice: The backup contains message text and metadata for the current account, without media files. Choose a trusted location. It is a readable JSON file, not an encrypted backup.
ArchiveImportNotice: Merge into the current account only. Existing copies are kept, duplicates ignored, and deliberately removed copies are not restored. Other accounts are ignored. Only import your own trusted backup.
ArchiveBusy: Finish or cancel the current file selection first.
ArchiveFailed: Could not read or write the archive. Your existing copies are preserved. Check storage space and the selected document.
ArchiveAccountChanged: The account changed. Choose the file again on the intended account.
InvalidArchive: This is not a valid supported archive for the current account, or it exceeds the size limit.
LocalDataIssue: Local storage needs attention. Recording may be paused if the archive is full. Export or remove unwanted copies; existing data is not silently discarded.
Desc_LocalReadPosition: Off by default. Resume the last visible message in chats where read receipts are hidden, separately per account and topic. Sends no read request. Restart after changing.
Desc_DurableDeletedMessages: Off by default. Requires Show deleted messages. Keeps future captured deletions in the separate copies page; up to 10,000 copies / 16 MiB. At the limit recording stops rather than deleting older copies. Secret/expiring media is excluded. Restart after changing.
Desc_ExtendedContentSaving: Off by default. Also enable Remove content-saving restrictions. Temporarily relax local message/private-chat checks while building menus or opening ordinary media; original metadata is restored. Does not send forwarded copies or unlock server permissions. Restart after changing.
Desc_HideSeenPrivateChat: Suppress private-chat read receipts. The server may continue to report older unread messages.
Desc_HideSeenChannel: Suppress channel/group read synchronization. Old unread counts may return after server refresh.
Desc_DisableStories: Hides the story lists. Posting stories may also be unavailable until this option is off and Telegram is restarted.
Desc_DownloadSpeed: Extra connections are used only for the download’s actual Premium account. Local Premium is not a real subscription.
Desc_CompatibilityStatus: Versions, local hook health and exact-APK test status. Nothing is sent to a server.
Desc_SaveEditsHistory: Keep previously cached text per account and conversation. Offline intermediate edits and uncached originals cannot be reconstructed.
Desc_ShowDeletedMessages: Keep server-deleted messages in Telegram’s current local cache. Enable independent copies to retain captured records through cache rebuilds.
Desc_AutoMuteNewChats: After a successful channel/group join or a first bot start, mute notifications using Telegram’s normal setting. Existing conversations stay unchanged; you can unmute manually. Restart required.
